tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — warm lab-notebook paper in light, near-black bench in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, the project list rows.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rules and card borders. Decorative only — never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥14:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, metadata, captions, taglines on `surface` and `surface-raised` (≥6:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal amber: links, the active nav item, primary button fill. Text use on `surface`/`surface-raised` passes 5:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (5.5:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Probe teal: inline code, tags, CVE/advisory labels, and the focus ring (solid 2px, ≥5.9:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fill behind callouts and a highlighted project row; text on it stays `ink`.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon-to-text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Card padding, list-row padding, paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; dot-grid pitch on the cover.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between page sections; top padding of the hero.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Portrait frame and the hero panel only.

meta.source: Starter system derived from public profile research (GitHub, press coverage); no existing brand assets.
